title: The Afternoon Nap — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 96bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish French language learning family Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The afternoon nap is a practice that requires no defence
But receives more justification than any choice in any tense
You sit down for a moment and the moment becomes twenty
And you wake with a resolution and a sense there's more than plenty

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La siesta es una práctica que no necesita defensa
[The afternoon nap is a practice that needs no defence]
Pero recibe más justificación que cualquier otro consenso
[But receives more justification than any other consensus]
Te sientas un momento y el momento se hace veinte minutos
[You sit down a moment and the moment becomes twenty minutes]
Y despiertas con la resolución y los frutos
[And you wake with resolution and the fruits]

[Chorus — English]
The afternoon nap knows something I don't know
It knows the brain reset that happens in the quarter hour below
The afternoon nap is not laziness — that's not the right address
It's maintenance of the instrument — that's the correct process
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
La sieste de l'après-midi est une pratique sans défense
[The afternoon nap is a practice without defence]
Mais reçoit plus de justifications que n'importe quelle tendance
[But receives more justifications than any other tendency]
Tu t'assieds un moment et le moment devient vingt minutes
[You sit down a moment and the moment becomes twenty minutes]
Tu te réveilles avec une résolution — c'est les tributes
[You wake up with a resolution — those are the tributes]

[Outro — All three languages]
Afternoon nap knows… La siesta sabe… La sieste sait
The reset is the work — El reinicio es el trabajo — La réinitialisation est le travail
That's my boy
